regime_context: Detector shows a defensives/healthcare-heavy topping board with Big Pharma as the headline narrative (eligible, durable, crowded), while the rank leader (Memory/HBM) is ineligible/trend-gate-off. Momentum rank is a focus lens only (rank-IC ~0), absolute-trend gate is the one validated edge, and gate_helps is true, so eligible=trend-ok themes are the only ones worth a directional lean.
emerging_watch: Watching whether the rank leader Memory/HBM (eligible=false, trend-gate off) regains eligibility via a durability-bar recovery toward 0.5+ — the rotation radar shows it leading by margin 0.456 over Big Pharma, but a confirmed handoff only exists if its trend-gate re-engages. If Memory/HBM stays eligible=false while Big Pharma keeps durability above 0.8, the watch retires.

theses.subject: Big Pharma
theses.thesis: Big Pharma is the confirmed headline narrative: eligible=true with high durability (0.85) and breadth 1.0, showing a cohesive trend. Crowding (z=1.48) flags a sizing caution only — it means don't pile in agressively, not fade it. The durable trend-gate pass is the only validated risk-control leg, and Big Pharma passes it cleanly.
evidence: crowded=true (z=1.48) — sizing caution, not a short/sell trigger
theses.dissent: The theme is crowded and the detector's momentum rank has weak rank-IC — the crowd is already positioned, so marginal flow can reverse fast; there is no forward-return edge here.

falsifier.text: PPH lags SPY by 5% before the 30-trading-day check-by date

theses.subject: Gold Miners
theses.thesis: Gold Miners is eligible=false with durability 0.28 — the absolute-trend gate is off, which is the detector's only validated drawdown-control edge. When gate_helps is true, being on the wrong side of the gate is the one consistently costly state. Not a short — just absent trend discipline.
theses.dissent: Gold miners are negatively crowded (z=-0.04) with low momentum — contrarian positioning could allow a quick mean-revert bounce that overweights the gate's trend logic.
